units.source_text: 再说，千重子如今听苗子这么一说，才第一次知道有关自己生身父母的情况：

en.t: Besides, only now, hearing Naeko speak of it this way, did Chieko learn for the first time about her birth parents:

units.source_text: 父亲是从杉树上掉下来摔死的，母亲也早已离开人世。

en.t: her father had fallen from a cedar tree and died, and her mother had also left this world long ago.
This pierced her heart with pain.
